sql.message: s.Order.lines: the column was dropped breaks rows that still hold its data
sql.help: migrate the column's data elsewhere before dropping it

xsd.message: s.Order.lines: the field was removed breaks old documents that still carry it
xsd.help: keep the field; an XSD document always carries every element

jsonschema.message: s.Order.lines: the field was removed breaks old documents that still carry it
jsonschema.help: keep the field, or mark the record @jsonschema(open)

proto.message: s.Line: the declaration was removed; generated code loses this type
proto.help: keep the type, or confirm nothing outside this schema still depends on it

sql.message: s.Line: the declaration was removed breaks reads of the table backing it
sql.help: drop the table only after migrating or archiving its data

xsd.message: s.Line: the declaration was removed breaks documents validated against it
xsd.help: keep the declaration, or confirm nothing outside this schema still depends on it

jsonschema.message: s.Line: the declaration was removed breaks documents validated against it
jsonschema.help: keep the declaration, or confirm nothing outside this schema still depends on it
